_comment: Recorded live and read-only on 2026-10-04 against intents.near 0.4.4 (rev a2dd140892b68140bf7e70814604d3ba074d656c, code hash EHTzkKyabhTGuKpvET5hBi7xPdKacuesMc91dDGkWvqb). Each entry is one bundle sent to simulate_intents, the NEAR RPC answer to it byte for byte (rpcBody), and the verdict the recording run printed for it (spike). run1 is the first run; run2 reran every test with new keys and added T10p, the rekey that also turns off auth by predecessor id, and its follow-ups. Every key in here was made for its run and thrown away: the secp256k1 keys lived in memory only, the P-256 keys inside a Secure Enclave and were never stored. Nothing was executed and no account holds anything.
